chapters.title: 1. Welcome to green school! Lesson 1

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 4. Посмотри на картинку, послушай запись и вспомни, как учитель мистер Гринвуд знакомится с учениками лесной школы.
steps: Фразы знакомства: What's your name? — My name is … / I am … Nice to meet you! Welcome!
problems.answer: Полезные фразы: What's your name? — My name is … Nice to meet you! Welcome to Green School!

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 4. Послушай запись и продолжи с одноклассником сцену знакомства по картинке.
steps: Mr Greenwood: What's your name? — Martin: My name is Martin. — Nice to meet you, Martin. What's your name? — Peter: I am Peter. — Welcome, Peter!
Дальше по кругу: Pam, Nick, Jack, Jane, Bess, Mary, Thomas, Billy — каждый называет своё имя, учитель отвечает Nice to meet you! / Welcome!
problems.answer: — What's your name? — My name is Martin. — Nice to meet you, Martin. What's your name? — I am Peter. — Welcome, Peter! (и так со всеми учениками: Pam, Nick, Jack, Jane, Bess, Mary, Thomas, Billy).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 4. Сосчитай учеников на картинке и скажи, кто они и как их зовут.
steps: There are ten pupils. He is a bear. His name is Billy. He is a pig. His name is Peter. He is a rabbit. His name is Martin. She is a monkey. Her name is Pam. He is a cockerel. His name is Nick.
He is a dog. His name is Jack. She is a cat. Her name is Jane. She is a fox. Her name is Bess. She is a mouse. Her name is Mary. He is an elephant. His name is Thomas.
problems.answer: Ten pupils: Billy the bear, Peter the pig, Martin the rabbit, Pam the monkey, Nick the cockerel, Jack the dog, Jane the cat, Bess the fox, Mary the mouse, Thomas the elephant.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 5. Посмотри на картинку на с. 4 и скажи, какая тема урока; вспомни и спой песенку «The ABC».
steps: На доске — буквы, значит тема урока — «The ABC» (алфавит). Поём песенку про алфавит.
problems.answer: The ABC.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 5. Послушай и прочитай слова.
steps: Читаем слова за диктором, обращая внимание на правила чтения гласных.
problems.answer: Слова читаются вслух за диктором.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 6, с. 5. Прочитай, что Билли рассказал об однокласснике, и догадайся, кто он.
steps: Он маленький, умеет прыгать и любит морковку — это кролик Мартин.
problems.answer: He is a rabbit (Martin).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 1, упр. 7, с. 5. Расскажи о своём однокласснике, не называя имени, по моделям в упражнении.
steps: Пример: I have got a friend. He is clever. He is not fat. He can play tennis. He cannot skate. We go to school together.
problems.answer: I have got a friend. He is clever. He is not fat. He can play tennis. He cannot skate. We go to school together.

problems.answer: Name — Dino; age — 7; can — skip and swim; family — mum and dad.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 6. Проверь внимательность соседа по парте: задай вопросы о цвете учебников.
steps: — Has Mary got a brown textbook? — No, she hasn't. She has got a black textbook. — Has Thomas got a brown textbook? — Yes, he has.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 7. Прочитай записку мистера Гринвуда, посмотри на картинки и назови учеников, которые неверно поняли задание.
steps: Задание поняли неверно Dino и Thomas.
problems.answer: Dino and Thomas.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 2, домашнее задание, с. 7. Напиши задания для учеников лесной школы по образцу.
steps: Thomas! Go home, please. Dino! Count the flowers, please. Jane! Go to school, please. Peter! Sing a song, please. Billy! Take four pencils, please.

steps: Например, песенка «Head, shoulders, knees and toes» — о частях тела: голова, плечи, колени, пальцы ног, глаза, уши, рот, нос.
problems.answer: Например, «Head, shoulders, knees and toes» — песенка о частях тела.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 8. Прочитай вопросы и ответь на них от лица одного из учеников лесной школы.
steps: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 9. a) Опроси одноклассников, что они умеют делать хорошо, и заполни таблицу. b) Скажи, кого возьмёшь в свою команду и почему.
steps: a) Can you run well? Can you swim well? Can you skip well? Can you jump well? — отмечаем ответы в таблице.
b) Пример: My team: Ksusha, Alexey and Damir. Ksusha can jump and run well. Alexey can swim well. Damir can skip, run and swim well.
problems.answer: a) Can you run / swim / skip / jump well? b) My team: Ksusha (can jump and run well), Alexey (can swim well), Damir (can skip, run and swim well).

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 3, домашнее задание, с. 9. Прочитай вопросы и ответь на них от лица одного из учеников лесной школы.
steps: My name is Mary. I'm a mouse. I'm nine. I live in the forest. Yes, I can. Yes, I can. No, I can't. No, I haven't.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 9. Послушай, какие продукты купила мисс Четтер, найди их на картинке и повтори названия.
steps: egg — яйцо, milk — молоко, ham — ветчина, fish — рыба, bread — хлеб, butter — масло, cheese — сыр, juice — сок, cake — торт, sweet — конфета.
problems.answer: egg, milk, ham, fish, bread, butter, cheese, juice, cake, sweets.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 10. Узнай у одноклассника, что он любит есть, по модели Do you like …?
steps: — Do you like sweets? — Yes, I do. — Do you like eggs? — No, I don't. — Do you like milk? — Yes, I do. — Do you like ham? — No, I don't. — Do you like fish? — No, I don't.
— Do you like bread? — Yes, I do. — Do you like butter? — Yes, I do. — Do you like cheese? — No, I don't. — Do you like juice? — No, I don't. — Do you like cakes? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: — Do you like sweets? — Yes, I do. — Do you like eggs? — No, I don't. (и так с каждым продуктом)

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 10. Прочитай слова и скажи, как буква a читается в каждой строчке.
steps: a) /æ/ — закрытый слог (cat, hat); b) /eɪ/ — открытый слог (name, cake); c) /ɑː/ — перед r (car, park).
problems.answer: a — /æ/, b — /eɪ/, c — /ɑː/.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 10. Прочитай словосочетания, назови номера подходящих рисунков и скажи, каких рисунков не хватает.
steps: Есть рисунки: a black car, a blue hat, a black cat. Не хватает рисунков: a dark park, a smart student, a brave dog.
problems.answer: Есть: a black car, a blue hat, a black cat. Не хватает: a dark park, a smart student, a brave dog.

steps: I like to fly! I like to swim! I like to run, jump and sing! — Я люблю летать, плавать, бегать, прыгать и петь.
problems.answer: I like to fly! I like to swim! I like to run, jump and sing!

problems.answer: Rex can take Jill's bag to school, count pens and pencils, sing songs and dance well.

problems.condition: Unit 1, Lesson 6, домашнее задание, с. 13. Составь и запиши предложения по образцу.
steps: I like to sing and dance well. You like to live in the forest. He likes to play tennis. She likes to read books at home. We like to skip in the park. They like to go home.

steps: I think they play computer games. I think they read books. I think they drink tea. I think they play football. I think they swim.
problems.answer: I think they play computer games, read books, drink tea and play football.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 36, упр. 4, с. 63. Прочитай текст и скажи, понравилось ли Деревенской Мышке в гостях и почему.
steps: No, she doesn't like her friend's house because there is a big cat there.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 36, упр. 6, с. 64. Заполни пропуски в предложениях.
steps: white, town, computer, dance.
problems.answer: white, town, computer, dance.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 36, упр. 7, с. 64. Расскажи о Деревенской Мышке.
steps: Country Mouse lives in the country. She is grey. She likes to read and draw. She can write poems. She doesn't like the town because of the big cat.
problems.answer: Country Mouse lives in the country. She is grey. She likes to read and draw and can write poems. She doesn't like the town.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 36, домашнее задание, с. 64. Расставь слова в правильном порядке.
steps: I live in the country. I can write and read. I do not like carrots and jam. I have got a friend. I visit my friend on Sundays.
problems.answer: I live in the country. I can write and read. I do not like carrots and jam. I have got a friend. I visit my friend on Sundays.

chapters.title: 3. Speaking about a new friend. Lesson 37

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 1, с. 64. Послушай запись и скажи, какие времена года любят Джим и Джилл.
steps: Jim likes summer and Jill likes autumn.
problems.answer: Jim likes summer, Jill likes autumn.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 2, с. 64. Послушай рассказы ещё раз и назови подходящие картинки.
steps: Jim — b, c. Jill — a, b.
problems.answer: Jim — b, c; Jill — a, b.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 3, с. 65. Назови любимое время года и скажи, чем любишь заниматься в это время.
steps: Пример: I like winter. I like to skate and play snowballs in winter.
problems.answer: I like winter. I like to skate and play snowballs in winter.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 4, с. 65. Спроси одноклассника о его любимом времени года и любимых занятиях.
steps: — What season do you like? — I like spring. — What do you like to do in spring? — I like to play football in the park and pick flowers.
problems.answer: — What season do you like? — I like spring. — What do you like to do in spring? — I like to play football in the park.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 5, с. 65. a) Послушай и прочитай названия месяцев. b) Назови месяцы, похожие по звучанию на русские. c) Назови месяцы в алфавитном порядке.

b) March, April, May, August, September, October. c) April, August, December, February, January, July, June, March, May, November, October, September.
problems.answer: a) January … December. b) March, April, May, August, September, October. c) April, August, December, February, January, July, June, March, May, November, October, September.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 6, с. 65. Найди ответы Джима и Джилл на вопросы мистера Гринвуда.
Unit 3, Lesson 37, упр. 7, с. 65. Дай свои ответы на вопросы из упражнения 6.
steps: Пример: No, I don't. In June, July and August. On Sundays. In the park. Summer.
problems.answer: No, I don't. In June, July and August. On Sundays. In the park. Summer.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 37, домашнее задание, с. 65. Заполни таблицу названиями месяцев по количеству дней.
steps: 31 день: January, March, May, July, August, October, December. 30 дней: April, June, September, November. 28 или 29 дней: February.
problems.answer: 31 — January, March, May, July, August, October, December; 30 — April, June, September, November; 28/29 — February.

chapters.title: 3. Speaking about a new friend. Lesson 38

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 1, с. 66. Послушай диалог и разыграй его по ролям.
steps: — Would you like some fish? — No, thank you. But I would like some cheese. — Would you like to go to the birthday party? — Yes, of course. I would.
problems.answer: — Would you like some fish? — No, thank you, but I'd like some cheese. — Would you like to go to the birthday party? — Yes, I would.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 2, с. 66. Скажи, чего бы тебе хотелось больше всего.
steps: I would like to visit Great Britain. I would like to do puzzles. I would like to speak English well. I would like to go to the birthday party. I would like to have lunch with Tiny. I would like to get a letter.
problems.answer: I would like to visit Great Britain, speak English well, go to the birthday party and get a letter.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 3, с. 66. Угадай заветные желания одноклассников.
steps: — Would you like to visit Great Britain? — Yes, I'd like to. / No, I wouldn't. — Would you like to do puzzles? — Yes, I'd like to. — Would you like to get a letter? — Yes, I'd like to.
problems.answer: — Would you like to visit Great Britain? — Yes, I'd like to. — Would you like to do puzzles? — No, I wouldn't.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 4, с. 67. Прочитай письмо и скажи, кому оно адресовано и от кого.
steps: Письмо адресовано мисс Четтер, а написала его мама Джима.
problems.answer: The letter is to Miss Chatter from Jim's mother.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 5, с. 67. Продолжи счёт порядковыми числительными.
steps: a) twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third, twenty-fourth, twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth, twenty-seventh, twenty-eighth, twenty-ninth, thirtieth.
b) thirtieth, fortieth, fiftieth, sixtieth, seventieth, eightieth, ninetieth, hundredth.
problems.answer: a) twenty-first … thirtieth; b) thirtieth, fortieth, fiftieth, sixtieth, seventieth, eightieth, ninetieth, hundredth.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 6, с. 67. Дополни предложения названиями месяцев.
steps: 1) May is the third month of spring. 2) July is the second month of summer. 3) September is the first month of autumn. 4) August is the eighth month of the year. 5) November is the eleventh month of the year. 6) December is the twelfth month of the year.
problems.answer: May, July, September, August, November, December.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 38, упр. 7, с. 67. Скажи, в каком месяце у тебя день рождения.
steps: Пример: My birthday is in October.
problems.answer: My birthday is in October.

chapters.title: 3. Speaking about a new friend. Lesson 39

steps: On Wednesday Tiny writes fairy tales for his friends. On Saturday Tiny plays computer games.
problems.answer: On Wednesday Tiny writes fairy tales. On Saturday he plays computer games.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 39, упр. 2, с. 69. Скажи, какая по порядку в алфавите каждая буква слова BIRTHDAY.
steps: B is the second letter. I is the ninth. R is the eighteenth. T is the twentieth. H is the eighth. D is the fourth. A is the first. Y is the twenty-fifth.
problems.answer: B — second, I — ninth, R — eighteenth, T — twentieth, H — eighth, D — fourth, A — first, Y — twenty-fifth.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 39, упр. 3, с. 69. Послушай и прочитай звуки, слова и предложения.
steps: Читаем за диктором звуки, слова с ними и предложения.
problems.answer: Звуки, слова и предложения читаются за диктором.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 39, упр. 4, с. 69. Скажи, когда дни рождения членов твоей семьи.
steps: Пример: My birthday is on the 25th of October. My mother's birthday is on the 2nd of July. My father's birthday is on the 11th of February. My sister's birthday is on the 6th of March.
problems.answer: My birthday is on the 25th of October. My mother's birthday is on the 2nd of July. My father's birthday is on the 11th of February.

steps: — When is your birthday? — My birthday is on the 6th of October.
problems.answer: — When is your birthday? — My birthday is on the 6th of October.

problems.answer: March, April, February, January, June, May, November, August, September, December, October, July.

problems.answer: the 2nd, 5th, 8th, 10th, 13th, 17th and 21st of February.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 1, с. 71. Послушай диалог и скажи, что ученики решили подарить другу.
steps: The pupils' present is a computer game.
problems.answer: A computer game.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 2, с. 71. Расскажи, какой подарок хотел(-а) бы получить на день рождения.
steps: I'd like to have a teddy bear. I'd like to have a bike. I'd like to have a book.
problems.answer: I'd like to have a bike / a teddy bear / a book.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 3, с. 71. Послушай и прочитай слова.
steps: /e/: February, second, September, teddy bear, tenth. /əʊ/: go, home, no, roller skates. /ʌ/: Monday, month, one, puzzle, summer, Sunday. /eɪ/: day, birthday, eighth, play, skate.
problems.answer: /e/ — February, second, September, teddy bear, tenth; /əʊ/ — go, home, no, roller skates; /ʌ/ — Monday, month, one, puzzle, summer, Sunday; /eɪ/ — day, birthday, play, skate.

problems.answer: A red ball, a nice teddy bear and a bone.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 5, с. 72. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: 1) His birthday is on the 28th of February. 2) He is three. 3) The dog, the cat and the rabbit. 4) Rex has ham, the dog has meat, the cat has fish, the rabbit has carrots. 5) Because they have a great time together.
problems.answer: On the 28th of February. He is three. The dog, the cat and the rabbit. Ham, meat, fish, carrots. Because they have a great time together.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 6, с. 72. Найди в тексте предложение, описывающее картинку, и прочитай его вслух.
steps: Картинку описывает предложение о друзьях Рекса, которые пришли на праздник: рыже-белая кошка, серый пёс и кролик.
problems.answer: His friends come to see him: a red and white cat, a grey dog and a rabbit.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, упр. 7, с. 72. Расскажи о дне рождения своего питомца.
steps: Пример: I have got a pet. It's a beautiful white cat. Her name is Fluffy. She is four. Her birthday is on the 7th of April. Her friend, a red cat, comes to see her. They play and have a tasty fish pie. Fluffy has got nice presents: a toy fish and a small ball.
problems.answer: I have got a white cat, Fluffy. She is four. Her birthday is on the 7th of April. Her friend comes, they play and eat fish pie. Her presents are a toy fish and a ball.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 40, домашнее задание, с. 72. Расскажи о важных для семьи датах.

problems.answer: The 11th of March is my mother's birthday. The 9th of August is my father's birthday. The 2nd of June is my granny's birthday. The 5th of April is my birthday.

steps: Поём поздравительную песню по записи.
problems.answer: Песня «Happy birthday to you!» поётся по записи.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 2, с. 73. Послушай диалог, прочитай его и разыграй с одноклассником.
steps: — Happy birthday to you! — Great! Thank you!
problems.answer: — Happy birthday to you! — Thank you!

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 3, с. 73. Дополни предложения по картинкам.

problems.answer: on the 10th of February; a ball, a teddy bear, a puzzle, a player, a computer, a scooter, roller skates; a birthday cake; play with the teddy bear / play computer games.

problems.answer: — Would you like to do puzzles? — No, thank you. — Do you like to play computer games? — Yes, of course. Have you got a new computer game? — Yes. Let's play!

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 5, с. 74. Послушай запись и проверь, правильно ли заполнены пропуски в диалоге из упражнения 4.
steps: Сверяем с записью: puzzles, play computer games, a new computer game, let's play.
problems.answer: Пропуски: puzzles; play computer games; a new computer game; Let's play.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 6, с. 74. Ответь на вопросы анкеты детского журнала.
steps: Пример: Do you like to play football? — Yes, I do. Do you like to play with a doll? — No, I don't. Do you like to roller skate? — Yes, I do. Do you like to ride a scooter? — Yes, I do. Do you like to sing and dance? — No, I don't. Do you like to read fairy tales? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. — по каждому вопросу анкеты.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 7, с. 74. Сравни свои ответы с ответами одноклассника.
steps: He doesn't like to play football, but I like to play football. He doesn't like to play with a doll, and I don't like it too. He doesn't like to roller skate, but I do. He likes to ride a scooter, and I like it too. He likes to sing and dance, but I don't.
problems.answer: He doesn't like to play football, but I do. He likes to ride a scooter, and I do too. He likes to sing and dance, but I don't.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, упр. 8, с. 74. Расскажи, как ты обычно отмечаешь день рождения.
steps: Пример: My birthday is on the 10th of September. My mum makes a birthday cake for me. In the evening my friends come to my party. They give me presents. We play, watch cartoons, eat cake and have fun.
problems.answer: My birthday is on the 10th of September. My mum makes a cake. My friends come to my party, give me presents, we play, eat cake and have fun.

problems.condition: Unit 3, Lesson 41, домашнее задание, с. 74. Дополни письмо в детский журнал о том, как ты отмечаешь день рождения.
steps: My birthday is on the 5th of October. I have got a birthday party. My friends and I listen to music, dance, watch cartoons, eat a birthday cake and have fun.
problems.answer: My birthday is on the 5th of October. I have a birthday party: my friends and I listen to music, dance, watch cartoons and eat a birthday cake.
